strings.MIND_FACT_RECALLABLE_FATIGUE: A memory of tiredness is available
strings.MIND_FACT_RECALLABLE_HUNGER: A memory of hunger is available
strings.MIND_FACT_RECALLABLE_SOCIAL: A memory of company is available
strings.MIND_FACT_RECALLABLE_THIRST: A memory of thirst is available
strings.MIND_FACT_ROUTINE_HEARTH_CIRCLE_AVAILABL: Gathering by the fire is available
strings.MIND_FACT_ROUTINE_SIT_BY_FIRE_AVAILABLE: Resting by the fire is available
strings.MIND_FACT_ROUTINE_WEIGHTED_PLACE_AVAILAB: A suitable activity place is available
strings.MIND_FACT_SEEKING: On the way to a destination
strings.MIND_FACT_STOCK_HOARD_ORDER: Supplies compared with the gathering limit
strings.MUX_ALERTS_DISMISS_TIP: Hide this alert until the condition clears and happens again.
strings.MUX_ALERT_FIREWOOD_LOW_FIX: Check F1 chopping and a workshop's maintain firewood bill.
strings.MUX_ALERT_FIREWOOD_LOW_WHY: Firewood is below daily need × cold days to prepare for.
strings.MUX_ALERT_FOOD_LOW_FIX: Provide forage access or designate a hunting zone with F1.
strings.MUX_ALERT_FOOD_LOW_WHY: Food reserves are below daily need × 3.
strings.MUX_ALERT_IDLE_ADULTS_FIX: Check work priorities with P and pending orders.
strings.MUX_ALERT_IDLE_ADULTS_WHY: An adult is neither working nor sleeping.
strings.MUX_ALERT_KNOWLEDGE_WAITING_FIX: Check T for the technique; teach with K or inspect migrants.
strings.MUX_ALERT_KNOWLEDGE_WAITING_WHY: No practitioner can carry out an order.
strings.MUX_ALERT_MEAT_SPOILING_FIX: Check F2 stockpiles and hauling priority with P.
strings.MUX_ALERT_MEAT_SPOILING_WHY: Meat outside stockpiles risks spoiling within a day, estimated from the global storage order.
strings.MUX_ALERT_MIGRANTS_WAITING_FIX: Press N to inspect and accept or decline the migrants.
strings.MUX_ALERT_MIGRANTS_WAITING_WHY: Migrants await your decision. The steward does not decide.
strings.MUX_ALERT_NEWBORN_WITHOUT_BED_FIX: Use F3 to place more beds in a roofed room.
strings.MUX_ALERT_NEWBORN_WITHOUT_BED_WHY: A household with a newborn has no assigned bed.
strings.MUX_ALERT_ORDERS_UNREACHABLE_FIX: Check doors and passages with F3, or cancel the order.
strings.MUX_ALERT_ORDERS_UNREACHABLE_WHY: Workers recently failed to reach these active work locations. Each location is counted once.
strings.MUX_ALERT_PERSON_BREAKDOWN_FIX: Inspect the cause and provide a safe place to rest.
strings.MUX_ALERT_PERSON_INJURED_FIX: Inspect them and release drafting with D to leave danger.
strings.MUX_ALERT_PERSON_SICK_FIX: Inspect the person and provide food, shelter and rest.
strings.MUX_ALERT_SLEEPING_OUTSIDE_FIX: Build an enclosed room, door and beds with F3.
strings.MUX_ALERT_SLEEPING_OUTSIDE_WHY: Someone is sleeping without a roof.
strings.MUX_ALERT_STOCKPILE_MISSING_FIX: Press F2 and drag a stockpile near camp.
strings.MUX_ALERT_STOREHOUSE_FULL_FIX: Check the storehouse with R and expand storage with F2.
strings.MUX_ALERT_TECHNIQUE_AT_RISK_FIX: Press K to teach another person.
strings.MUX_ALERT_TECHNIQUE_AT_RISK_WHY: Only one person can practice this technique.
strings.MUX_ALERT_TRADER_PRESENT_FIX: Press N to inspect the trader and choose a trade.
strings.MUX_ALERT_WOLVES_APPROACHING_FIX: Select people and press D to draft, then move them to safety.
strings.MUX_ALERT_WOLVES_APPROACHING_WHY: A dangerous predator is close to camp.
strings.MUX_CONTROL_CANCEL_ORDER: Cancel orders, blueprints or hunt marks
strings.MUX_CONTROL_CLOSE: Close detail panels and menus (C/Q use their own keys)
strings.MUX_CONTROL_DRAFT: Draft or release the selected person
strings.MUX_CONTROL_DRAFT_ORDER: Move drafted people or attack a target
strings.MUX_CONTROL_MENU_GATHER: Quarry / clay / marked hunt / hunt zone

strings.MUX_CONTROL_ORDER_AREA: Designate an area or a wall/floor line
strings.MUX_CONTROL_ORDER_RECTANGLE: Hollow wall rectangle / filled floor rectangle
strings.MUX_CONTROL_RENDER_RELOAD: Reload render settings in debug builds
strings.MUX_CONTROL_SELECT: Select a person, room, workshop or visitor
strings.MUX_CONTROL_STEWARD: Toggle basic automatic orders and scope
strings.MUX_GOALS_NO_MARKERS: Inspect the technology map for the next marker techniques.
strings.MUX_GOAL_HOUSE: An enclosed house with beds for everyone
strings.MUX_GOAL_WINTER: Survive the first winter with everyone alive

strings.MUX_LESSON_ALERTS_BODY: Click a right-edge alert to visit its cause and read how to fix it.
strings.MUX_LESSON_ALERTS_STEWARD: The village did this itself. To do it yourself: Click a right-edge alert to visit its cause and read how to fix it.
strings.MUX_LESSON_BILLS_BODY: Build and inspect a workshop, then add a maintain bill for supplies.
strings.MUX_LESSON_BILLS_STEWARD: The village prepared these orders. To do it yourself: Build and inspect a workshop, then add a maintain bill for supplies.
strings.MUX_LESSON_CAMERA_BODY: Pan with two fingers or a drag, zoom, then move using the minimap.
strings.MUX_LESSON_CAMERA_STEWARD: The village did this itself. To do it yourself: Pan with two fingers or a drag, zoom, then move using the minimap.
strings.MUX_LESSON_CHOP_BODY: Choose F1 or Chop and mark trees in the forest.
strings.MUX_LESSON_CHOP_STEWARD: The village did this itself. To do it yourself: Choose F1 or Chop and mark trees in the forest.
strings.MUX_LESSON_DRAFTING_BODY: Select a person and press D to draft. The steward never decides to draft people.
strings.MUX_LESSON_DRAFTING_STEWARD: The village did this itself. To do it yourself: Select a person and press D to draft. The steward never decides to draft people.
strings.MUX_LESSON_HOUSE_BODY: Place walls, a door and bedrolls with F3. Make an enclosed room with a bed for everyone.
strings.MUX_LESSON_HOUSE_STEWARD: The village prepared these orders. To do it yourself: Place walls, a door and bedrolls with F3. Make an enclosed room with a bed for everyone.
strings.MUX_LESSON_NEIGHBOURS_BODY: Open N or Neighbours to inspect migrants. You always decide whether to accept them.
strings.MUX_LESSON_NEIGHBOURS_STEWARD: The village did this itself. To do it yourself: Open N or Neighbours to inspect migrants. You always decide whether to accept them.
strings.MUX_LESSON_PERSON_BODY: Click a person on the map to inspect their portrait and condition.
strings.MUX_LESSON_PERSON_STEWARD: The village did this itself. To do it yourself: Click a person on the map to inspect their portrait and condition.
strings.MUX_LESSON_PRIORITIES_BODY: Open work priorities with P or the Work button.
strings.MUX_LESSON_PRIORITIES_STEWARD: The village did this itself. To do it yourself: Open work priorities with P or the Work button.
strings.MUX_LESSON_ROOMS_BODY: Use R or Show rooms to inspect the finished rooms.
strings.MUX_LESSON_ROOMS_STEWARD: The village did this itself. To do it yourself: Use R or Show rooms to inspect the finished rooms.
strings.MUX_LESSON_SPEED_BODY: Use the speed buttons. Space pauses; 1–4 select speed.
strings.MUX_LESSON_SPEED_STEWARD: The village did this itself. To do it yourself: Use the speed buttons. Space pauses; 1–4 select speed.
strings.MUX_LESSON_STOCKPILE_BODY: Choose F2 or Stockpile, then drag an area of ground.
strings.MUX_LESSON_STOCKPILE_STEWARD: The village did this itself. To do it yourself: Choose F2 or Stockpile, then drag an area of ground.
strings.MUX_LESSON_TEACHING_BODY: Inspect the technology map with T and order teaching with K. Complete a real teaching session.
strings.MUX_LESSON_TEACHING_STEWARD: The village prepared these orders. To do it yourself: Inspect the technology map with T and order teaching with K. Complete a real teaching session.
strings.MUX_LESSON_WAIT: Complete the action above to continue.
strings.MUX_SETTING_STEWARD_NOTE: Use the top-bar steward button to change the current village.
